<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 1.49.0 -->

## What's Changed
### Breaking Changes 🛠
* Clean up experimental dialog, fragment and widget replay by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12167
* Deprecate `st.bokeh_chart` in favour of `streamlit-bokeh` component by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12168
* Allow editing of `ListColumn` via `st.data_editor` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12261
### New Features 🎉
* [feat] Add configurable websocket ping interval to fix proxy connection drops by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12117
* Add directory support for st.file_uploader by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11905
* Add support for sparkline charts to `st.metric` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9675
* [feat] Simplify all copy to clipboard handling by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12141
* Allow setting `duration` for `st.toast` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11872
* [AdvancedLayouts] Updates dataframe and data editor to the new style for width and height.  by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11930
* Add an option for a wider `st.dialog` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12040
* Add single- and multi-cell selections to `st.dataframe` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11393
* Show check icon on column name copy by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12172
* Added st.pdf by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11532
* Add single- and multi-cell selection options to `st.dataframe` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8952
* Add `key` to `st.form_submit_button` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12190
* Add toolbar action to show underlying vega chart data by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10311
* [AdvancedLayouts] Updates to st.image width/height and adding width/height to st.pyplot.  by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11952
* Add `yellow` to text/background/badge/divider color options by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12201
* Add explicit support for Pydantic models in cache_data/resource by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12137
* Add directory upload support to st.chat_input by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12105
* Update slider value on mouse release by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11879
* Add `format_func` support to `SelectboxColumn` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12232
* [AdvancedLayouts] Adds a width parameters to graphviz charts. by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12212
* Allow select all/ deselect all when hiding dataframe columns from UI by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12164
### Bug Fixes 🐛
* [fix] Skeleton width should be full screen. by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12100
* [fix] st.chat_input collapses after submit by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12132
* [fix] iframe and html change in default width when no width specified. by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12148
* [Fix] `st.toast` handles custom theming by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12160
* [fix] Do not allow removing already uploaded files when disabled by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12180
* Ensure narrow currency symbol is used for formatting by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11895
* Revert "Make st.logout use end_session_endpoint if provided in OIDC config (#11901)" by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12179
* [fix] Allow dismissing connection error dialog (and not having it continue to pop up) by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12178
* [fix] Cache layout_config data and use during replay by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12183
* Update `st.page_link` radii config by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12181
* Single mark charts use first of `chartCategoricalColors` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12162
* [fix] File Upload Drop Target truncates subtext by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12192
* Update credentials.py: try to fix showEmailPrompt in case where there is no email by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12202
* [fix] Selectbox with accept_new_options on mobile shows keyboard by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12219
* [fix] PlotlyChart with null value selection works properly by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12222
* Fix: prevents underlying column menu from opening when column visibility menu is open for `st.dataframe` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12233
* Apply radii from theme to `CheckboxColumn` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12263
* [fix] Log deprecation warning for use_container_width in `st.dataframe` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12277
### Other Changes
* Release/1.48.0 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12126
* Theming: Remove colored decoration line by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12155
* [Fix] `st.time_input` hover for dropdown by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12157
* Release/1.48.1 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12185
* Make crossorigin property configurable for st.logo by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12226
* Update material symbols by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12264

## New Contributors
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12233

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/compare/1.48.1...1.49.0
